targets.note: targets of each deferred family are listed in relationship_families

transforms.nbr6: mean over the 6 nearest spots within sample (KD-tree; a spot without neighbours keeps its own value)
transforms.nbr18: mean over the 18 nearest spots within sample
transforms.note: the transform grammar of morpheus_encoder.learned_search.propose (prefixed names own:/nbr6:/nbr18:/contrast:); every proposer receives the same transformed design

discovery.candidate_variables: per family candidate_views under the four transforms: raw_genes = the D_P-selected 768 highly variable genes (log1p-CPM, within-patient centred, z-scored on D_P); programmes = 41 Gavish + 50 Hallmark scores; morph_concepts = the 64 concept coordinates; scimilarity / scgpt as v0.6

target_exclusions.rule: for a programme target, candidate programme and gene-set scores whose gene-set overlap coefficient with the target set (|A intersect B| / min(|A|, |B|)) is >= 0.2 are excluded, as are the target's own member genes, in addition to the within-patient |r| >= 0.9 leak guard; the excluded names are recorded per episode
target_exclusions.why: the stub smokes showed near-copy target/candidate pairs, e.g. the Gavish Hypoxia meta-programme as target with HALLMARK_HYPOXIA as candidate; these share genes and score the same transcripts, so the 'relation' is the gene sets' overlap, not biology; this rule removes them
target_exclusions.implementation: Agent D (hest_multi episode exclusions), recorded under the episode's exclusions

excluded_from_candidates: for programme targets: the target programme under every transform, and any column with within-patient |r| >= 0.9 to the target or to its own k=6 neighbour mean on proposal rows (leak guard, listed per fold)
for morph_concept targets: every morph_concept and H-Optimus-0 column (the target is a function of that embedding) and CellViT descriptors

comparison_model.patient: patient enters by within-patient standardisation of the response and every column (as v0.5)
comparison_model.rule: the comparison model is nuisance-only: log depth, patient centring, platform and study one-hots; fit on D_P and frozen; gain = R2(comparison + hypothesis, D_R) - R2(comparison, D_R) under relation v07_ho
comparison_model.why: see renal_spatial_v07_notes.md: biological explanations are not competitors here, they are reported as the explanation decomposition
comparison_model.platform_note: single platform (Visium); platform enters only if sections differ in chemistry

family_additions.tumour_budding: nuclear-shape statistics from the CellViT segmentation (mean eccentricity, orientation dispersion) enter the nuisance ridge for this family only (cross-section check)

explanation_decomposition.status: reported for every receipt row and every frozen hypothesis, never a gate
explanation_decomposition.baselines: training spec 0.8 under relation v03_rff (Agent M 25fce7e): B_nuis = nuisance ridge (log depth; per-patient intercepts = within-patient standardisation); B_known = nuisance + the hest_multi programme scores (Hallmark + Gavish) after the target's exclusions (the target programme, its member genes, |r| >= 0.9 proxies and every programme with gene-set overlap coefficient >= 0.2 removed) + the three composition variables (CellViT PanNuke Neoplastic / Inflammatory / Connective fractions where every sample has a segmentation, else the top three programme principal axes; source recorded in episode_info.composition_source), ridge with LOPO penalty on D_P; B_decomp(S) = the best proper partition of S in the same family

row_fields.B_nuis: gain_B_nuis with gain_B_nuis_ci (identical to decomposition.gain_general / gain_general_ci and replication_gain / replication_gain_ci)
row_fields.B_known: gain_B_known with gain_B_known_ci (decomposition.gain_known / gain_known_ci; support LOPO decomposition.gain_known_proposal; columns used in decomposition.known_covariates)
row_fields.B_decomp: G_HO_B_decomp with G_HO_B_decomp_ci and best_decomposition (decomposition.G_HO / G_HO_ci; decomposition.gain_decompositions, gain_joint_vs_additive); the receipt's best_decomposition is chosen on held-out gain inside each bootstrap draw

explanation_decomposition.replaces: the N/B1/B2/B3 ladder (dbench.scripts.decomposition_ladder), which does not run under v03_rff in the hest_multi runner; no ladder step is run for these campaigns

pass_counts.reported: per cohort and per family, from funnel_aggregate.json baseline_pass_counts (dbench.prospective_campaign; same pass rule: >= 3 of 5 folds, required structured nulls p <= 0.05, BH q <= 0.10 within family): passes B_nuis (the internal rule); passes B_known (folds restricted to gain_B_known CI lower bound > 0); passes B_decomp (folds restricted to higher_order rows); passes B_known and B_decomp
pass_counts.status: nothing gated; the finding classes A-F keep their meaning
pass_counts.downstream: external replication and characterisation run on every B_nuis pass as before
pass_counts.paper_object_count: the B_known column, with the higher-order (B_known and B_decomp) subset marked
pass_counts.state_cards: the validation section of every state card carries the four passes and their folds

null_suite.spatial_block: within-patient 2D block swap (6x6 grid) of the response on D_R (destroys spatial organisation, keeps marginals)
null_suite.within_patient_perm: permutation of the response within patient on D_R
null_suite.interaction_break: for |S| >= 2, within-patient block swap of one constituent variable on D_R (breaks joint structure, keeps marginals)

advance_rule.proposed: per relationship family: top 50 hypotheses by mean held-out gain over folds in which they PASSED, ranked across proposers jointly; provenance kept (as v0.5)
advance_rule.internal: passing in >= 3 of 5 folds, mean gain over passing folds >= min_gain (0.01), all required structured nulls p <= 0.05 in every passing fold, BH q <= 0.10 within family (as v0.5)
advance_rule.external: external spatial replication: the 10x FFPE colorectal sections ('reserve_ffpe_human_colorectal_cancer...') if patient-level metadata allow and they are absent from meta-training; tenx_demo_bowel is excluded (used to build the v03 morphology dictionary); otherwise unavailable
advance_rule.passing_fold: held-out full-model R2 > 0, gain patient-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND within_patient_perm null p <= 0.05 (the v0.5 rule; runner 'validated' carries exactly this rule)
advance_rule.per_patient_concentration: reported per hypothesis; a flag, never a gate

pooling.rule: the registered pooling step scores every frozen hypothesis in every fold, including the folds in which it was not frozen (each fold's held-out patients predicted from a fit on that fold's proposal patients, with the frozen variables, transforms and relation unchanged), so the pooled out-of-fold gain, its patient-bootstrap CI and the pooled nulls cover all patients; the folds in which the hypothesis was frozen are recorded beside it
pooling.budget_lifted_rule: every hypothesis group passing the fold rule in >= 3 folds enters the finding stage (no top-50 cut at the finding stage); the registered finding rule applies; BH q <= 0.10 within family over ALL entrants; then near-duplicate collapse (nbr6 / nbr18 versions of a variable count as the same core name) and the second_catalogue_known / target_leak flags are applied
pooling.ledger_note: candidate_budget is null: no per-family cut at the finding stage; the ledger freezes every entrant (a group passing the fold rule in >= 3 folds, scored in every scoreable fold by the registered cross-fold stage)
pooling.pass_and_multiplicity: fold pass and the internal rule as v0.5 (advance_rule); BH q <= 0.10 within family over all entrants of the finding stage
pooling.implementation: dbench.prospective_campaign._aggregate_families, native budget-lifted mode (budget_lifted(discovery); candidate_budget null); test dbench/tests/test_budget_lifted_pooling.py reproduces the supplementary v2 counts on the registered Meylan (244 B_known, 11 B_decomp, 1 both) and ependymoma fold receipts; the collapse (Jaccard >= 0.5 single linkage on variable sets, nbr6 / nbr18 versions one core name) and the second_catalogue_known / target_leak flags are the reporting layer of dbench/downstream/scripts/bknown_semantics.py applied to the aggregate; receipts and ledger are read only by the reporting layer; the aggregation-stage code commit is recorded in the driver log
pooling.supersedes_for_this_protocol: the earlier 'collapse then top-50 by B_known' proposal is not used

discovery.higher_order_flag: receipt row field higher_order = (G_HO patient-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0) AND (held-out full-model R2 > 0) under relation v03_rff, where G_HO = held-out gain(full) - max over proper partitions of held-out gain(partition), the maximum taken inside every bootstrap draw; the funnel tallies n_fold_rows_higher_order and n_frozen_higher_order beside the validated counts

outputs.general_discoveries: internal hypotheses (rule above) regardless of shape: linear, additive, conditional or joint; each with pooled general gain + CI, the per-row B_known and B_decomp gains and its proposer
outputs.higher_order_discoveries: the subset of general discoveries with k >= 2 whose pooled G_HO (relation v03_rff decomposition family) has a patient-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 with pooled held-out full-model R2 > 0; per-fold rows carry higher_order
outputs.note: a discovery is never dropped for being linear or simple; G_HO only marks which discoveries additionally require the joint object

stop_rules: a family with no internal hypothesis at budget 50: every hypothesis logged with stop_reason and proposer; reported; the advance rule never changes post hoc
sign reversal on any patient-level external transfer: the hypothesis stops at internal; hash stays locked
a proposer that fails to load (missing checkpoint or module) stops the run with a clear message; it is never silently replaced

learned_search.description: morpheus_encoder.learned_search.propose with the frozen checkpoint; runner --proposer learned_search; ranked variable sets under the four transforms, concept variables via its concept layer

classical_pair.description: runner --proposer classical_pair: dbench.benchmark.methods ebm_ga2m (EBM GA2M pairwise terms) and gbm_interaction (gradient boosting + Friedman H) on the same proposal rows and design, their ranked lists interleaved by rank (run_general_discovery_packet._classical_pair_pool)

proposers.budget: equal: each proposer emits up to proposals_per_target hypotheses per (target, fold)
proposers.merge: interleaved rank, as the runner merges the two classical methods: learned_search rank 1, classical_pair rank 1, learned_search rank 2, ...; a hypothesis nominated by both keeps its first position and records both proposers; the first proposals_per_target unique hypotheses are frozen
proposers.no_cv_reranking: the pooled proposals are NOT re-ranked by cross-validated proposal gain (on Agent V's full-size cell that step took 8 h); implemented by the runner's --proposer all under merge_rule interleaved_rank (commit 6eda3cd)

discovery.relation_note: the governing spec's fixed family (morpheus_training_and_evaluation_spec.md 0.7), morpheus_encoder.learned_search.relation_v03 (Agent M, commit bfc40ed): kernel ridge on 256 random Fourier features of the set (Gaussian kernel, median-heuristic bandwidth on proposal rows, fixed RFF directions per set size, RFF_SEED 20261021) plus the set linearly plus an intercept; inputs standardised by proposal-row statistics; penalty from {0.01, 0.1, 1, 10} by leave-one-patient-out CV on proposal rows; fitted to the response after the nuisance ridge (log depth; per-patient intercepts = within-patient standardisation; penalty from {0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000} by LOPO); general gain = R2(nuisance + f_S, D_R) - R2(nuisance, D_R) with a 200-draw held-out-patient bootstrap CI; decomposition family = every proper set partition of S, each block its own 256-RFF map, fitted jointly; nulls unchanged (spatial_block, within_patient_perm, interaction_break; the protocol's draw count; p = (1 + #null >= observed)/(draws + 1)), re-scoring the fixed proposal fit on nulled D_R (interaction_break re-predicts with the first constituent block-swapped); validation rule unchanged (held-out full R2 > 0 and gain CI lower bound > 0); batched on the GPU
discovery.response_transform: every response is within-patient standardised (mean 0, sd 1 per patient on its own values)
discovery.rows: spots with an H-Optimus-0 embedding (coverage-complete for concept targets and concept candidates); the kept fraction is recorded per fold and target; nothing is imputed
